data.name: Geoffry
data.gender_notes: Geoffry is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Geoffry is derived from Old French Geoffroi, which means 'ploughman' or 'god-given ploughman'. The name is rooted in Germanic Gaufrid, which translates to 'ploughman' and 'god-given'. In the Middle Ages, this name was popular among knights and farmers who embodied the virtues of hard work and faith. The name Geoffry carries the meaning “God's ploughman” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Geoffry usually hope their child will grow to embody god's ploughman and live with faith, good character and purpose.
